user_name_ko = #{userNameKo}, user_name_en = #{userNameEn}, user_email = #{userEmail}, user_mobile_no = #{userMobileNo}, user_tel_no = #{userTelNo}, user_fax_no = #{userFaxNo}, user_post_no = #{userPostNo}, user_addr = #{userAddr}, user_addr_detail = #{userAddrDetail}, dept_name = #{deptName}, user_position = #{userPosition}, user_type_code = #{userTypeCode}, work_status_code = #{workStatusCode}, employ_status_code = #{employStatusCode}, acct_status_code = #{acctStatusCode}, role_seq = #{roleSeq}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT I.user_info_seq, I.user_mst_seq, E.office_seq, I.user_name_ko, I.user_name_en, I.user_email, I.user_mobile_no, I.user_tel_no, I.user_fax_no, I.user_post_no, I.user_addr, I.user_addr_detail, I.dept_name, I.user_position, (SELECT CONCAT(fr.repository_url, '/', fm.file_nm) FROM utb_file_mapp fp JOIN utb_file_mst fm ON fp.file_seq = fm.file_seq AND fm.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_file_repository fr ON fm.file_repository_seq = fr.file_repository_seq WHERE fp.tbl_seq = I.user_info_seq AND fp.file_category_code = 'profileImage' AND fp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY fp.create_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS profile_image_url, I.create_at, I.del_yn, E.office_employee_seq, E.admin_auth, E.office_employee_position, E.office_employee_dept, E.work_code, E.position_code, E.job_grade_code, E.dept_seq, I.user_type_code, (SELECT cd_nm FROM utb_code_dtl WHERE grp_cd = 'USER_TYPE' AND dtl_cd = I.user_type_code AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1) AS user_type_name, I.work_status_code, (SELECT cd_nm FROM utb_code_dtl WHERE grp_cd = 'WORK_STATUS' AND dtl_cd = I.work_status_code AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1) AS work_status_name, I.employ_status_code, (SELECT cd_nm FROM utb_code_dtl WHERE grp_cd = 'EMPLOY_STATUS' AND dtl_cd = I.employ_status_code AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1) AS employ_status_name, I.acct_status_code, (SELECT cd_nm FROM utb_code_dtl WHERE grp_cd = 'ACCT_STATUS' AND dtl_cd = I.acct_status_code AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1) AS acct_status_name, E.role_seq, (SELECT role_nm FROM utb_role_mst WHERE role_seq = E.role_seq AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1) AS role_name FROM utb_office_employee E INNER JOIN utb_user_info I ON E.user_mst_seq = I.user_mst_seq AND I.del_yn = 'N' WHERE E.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND E.del_yn = 'N' AND (E.acct_status_code IS NULL OR E.acct_status_code != 'PENDING')
